notes.title: Major Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Bug #1: When right clicking to view unit stats, player was unable to select a unit after resulting in game being stalled.
Fix Applied: Player can freely select or reselect any of their units after right clicking to view their stats

Bug #2: When playing the 'Hard' level, the Queen's would not take their turn resulting in game being stalled.
Fix Applied: Fixed scripts to rework the Queen's turn so that game doesn't stall.
